usage.finalMessage:
I added the `owes <member>` command, and borrowing is now refused when a member owes more than 5.00 (exactly 5.00 is allowed). `dotnet test Lending.slnx` passes all 22 tests, and the work is committed.
R3 is only partly done: staff skip the money-owed check, but holds (DEC-005) and suspensions (L01-R2) still block their borrows. R3 conflicts with both, and the README says a requirement can't overrule an accepted decision, so only the Head of Lending can change that.
The open question is recorded in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
